feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report containing no listed features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists concise summaries of multiple frontend components and pages for reference.

frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with navigation, authentication controls, and role‑based access to dashboard, notebook, and game pages.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal form that collects a user's name and role and saves the profile via a mutation.

frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, OCR data, and questions through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining color themes, dark mode variables, and utility classes.

frontend/src/pages/AashaStorePage.tsx: Store page displaying redeemable items, checking user coin balance, and handling mock purchase flow.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with hero imagery, journey description, and registration details for the foundation.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Empty file with no content provided.
frontend/src/pages/AuctionPage.tsx: Implements a bidding interface with mock auction data, authentication checks, and a bid submission dialog.
frontend/src/pages/DonateGoodsPage.tsx: Provides a goods donation form, category listing, and foundation address with clipboard copy support.
frontend/src/pages/DonateMoneyPage.tsx: Displays donation information with a placeholder for upcoming payment integration and informational cards.
frontend/src/pages/EcoSevaPage.tsx: Presents Eco‑Seva program details including environmental activities, mission info, and sapling adoption.
frontend/src/pages/EmpowermentPage.tsx: Shows the empowerment program overview with imagery, vision details, and pillars of child development.
